description: Due-diligence card for one paper (arXiv id, SSRN id or arXiv URL). Answers, each with a status and verbatim quotes from the paper: what it proposes; the assumptions its results depend on; the datasets it used (name, provider, period, universe, and stable ids for well-known vendors); whether transaction costs are in its headline results; the findings it reports; which papers by other authors support, contradict or qualify those findings, and how other corpus papers cite it; and whether an implementation is public. Everything is the authors' own claim; nothing is reproduced. Support and contradiction are sparse, model-judged pointers. A status of not_extracted means the paper has not been processed, not that the answer is no.
name: get_paper_evidence
title: Get one paper's evidence card
